errors.text_span: der dunkelviolette Balken den Wert von 60 Prozent des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten
errors.evidence: The description says 'dunkelviolette' (dark purple), but the bars for 60% of median wage are shown in light purple.
The final value for the blue bars in 2025 is stated as 12.82 Euros, but the figure shows about 12.41 Euros.
The description does not mention the title 'Angaben in Euro pro Stunde, Jahresmittelwert' shown on the figure.
